Privacy Policy

Last Updated: April 28, 2026 At RVParkSales.com and RVParkSuccess.com, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard personal information from visitors to our website RVParkSales.com and RVParkSuccess.com, including those inquiring about properties. By using our Site, you consent to the practices described here.

Information We Collect

We collect personal information you voluntarily provide, such as:
  • Contact Details: Name, email address, phone number, and mailing address.
  • Inquiry Data: Property preferences, budget, timeline, and details about your real estate needs.
  • Account Information: If you create an account, username, password, and profile details.
  • Payment Information: Billing details for services (processed securely via third-party providers).
We also automatically collect:
  • Technical Data: IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, and time stamps.
  • Cookies and Tracking: Usage data via cookies, pixels, and similar technologies for analytics and personalization.
How We Collect Information
  • Directly from You: Through contact forms, property inquiry submissions, newsletters sign-ups, or account registration. Automatically: Via cookies, server logs, and analytics tools like Google Analytics.
  • From Third Parties: Public records, MLS listings, or partners (e.g., mortgage providers) with your consent.

How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:
  • Respond to property inquiries and provide real estate services.
  • Send updates on listings, market trends, or personalized recommendations.
  • Process transactions and manage accounts.
  • Improve our Site, analyze trends, and prevent fraud.
  • Comply with legal obligations.
Sharing Your Information We share information only as needed:
  • Service Providers: Hosting, email, analytics (e.g., Google), and CRM tools bound by confidentiality.
  • Business Partners: With your consent, e.g., lenders or inspectors for inquiries.
  • Legal Requirements: To comply with laws, subpoenas, or protect rights.
  • Business Transfers: In mergers or sales.
We do not sell your personal information.

Data Security

We implement reasonable security measures (e.g., encryption, firewalls) to protect your data. However, no system is fully secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute protection.

Data Retention

We retain information as long as needed for business or legal purposes (3 years for transaction records), then securely delete or anonymize it.

Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have rights to:
  • Access, correct, or delete your data.
  • Opt out of marketing or sales.
  • Restrict processing or withdraw consent.
  • Data portability.
  • To exercise rights, email Marie@rvparksales.com. We respond within 30-45 days.
California Residents (CCPA/CPRA): You have rights to know, delete, and opt-out of sales/sharing. No sales occur, but opt-out is respected via "Do Not Sell/Share My Info" link. EU/UK (GDPR/UK GDPR): Lawful bases include consent and contract necessity. Contact our EU Representative if needed. Children: We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13 (or 16 in some jurisdictions). Contact us if you believe we have.

Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies for functionality, analytics, and ads. Manage preferences via browser settings or our cookie banner. [Link to Cookie Policy].

International Transfers

Data may be transferred to the US or other countries with adequate protections (e.g., Standard Contractual Clauses).
